name: zclass_cls_di_filter_points_bbox
description: zClass_cls_di::FilterPointsBBox rejects nodes whose view bounding box cannot overlap the active DI segment and optionally tests bbox faces for point-candidate nodes.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this bbox filter; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass cls_di source-cluster pass.
Binary Ninja HLIL renders the x87 min/max and bounds comparisons through reused float locals, so functional evidence is tied to the inspected assembly and native smoke.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x447540 validates the node flag 0x100 early rejection, gwNodeGetViewBBoxCorners dependency, bbox min/max scan across eight corners, rejection against g_DiSegmentMin/Max X/Y/Z, optional flag 0x20 call to BuildPickCandidatesForSegmentVsBBoxFaces using g_DiPickCandidateCursor, g_DiPickQueryPoint, and g_DiSegmentEnd, return 1 for filtered-out nodes, and return 0 for accepted nodes.

The native cls_di smoke verifies missing bbox flag rejection, segment/bbox overlap acceptance, outside-segment rejection, point-candidate bbox-face hit acceptance, and point-candidate bbox-face miss rejection.
